claims.statement: June2 Assembly Finance Committee recommended immediate government adoption of 6000 across all imports
claims.preciseConflict: Committee favored 2500 on controlled goods and 4000-5000 for others; Finance Minister June4 foresaw 6000 counterpart rate while retaining 2500 general official rate.
claims.adversarialMethod: Compare official stage, independent press or later US/UK records; do not infer execution from statements.

claims.statement: June4 Baek Du-jin announced a uniform legal USD rate of 6000
claims.preciseConflict: Minister distinguishes 6000 counterpart rate and 2500 general rate; fertilizer coal and oil possible exceptions.
